candidate.scope: Only mature cold tokens; the final 128-token protected window is unchanged.

validated_actual_dms_screening.single_request_b4_m0: One qasper request passed the B=4 transform mask gate; actual removed fraction 0.5112144420131292 matched the offline estimate 0.5116171286165816.

stratified9.screening_metrics: QA F1 and whitespace-token ROUGE-L only; these are not official LongBench metrics.
stratified9.b4_m025_vs_original: Six QA screening scores were unchanged. The three qmsum ROUGE-L deltas were -0.0207, +0.0319, and -0.0371; sample-level variation remains unresolved.

offline_structural_metrics.interpretation: B=4,m=+0.25 recovers about four percentage points of logical deletion over B=4,m=0, but remains materially less sparse than original KVzap.

assumptions.read_proxy: one query reading all allocated active KV plus page metadata

phase3_timeline_layout_estimate.tail_result: B=4,m=+0.25 lowers mean page allocation but does not lower the mean request-level P95 or maximum per-layer/head timeline-page count in this sample.
phase3_timeline_layout_estimate.counterfactual_lower_bound: For page=16, arbitrary-token packed original KVzap has 2.9502x compression versus 2.1328x for B=4,m=+0.25; Route A can therefore retain substantially more potential compression if it can compact token-level sparsity.

decision.route_b_status: Conditional backup only. It is beneficial only under the tested timeline-page allocation model where arbitrary token compaction is unavailable.
decision.accuracy_action: Do not expand B=4,m=+0.25 to the complete 45-request accuracy screen now.
decision.route_a_status: Primary next direction: model predict-at-creation / compact-at-maturity KV lifecycle and token/page compaction costs while preserving the original KVzap mask.

valid_for: Reproducing the bounded B=4 candidate screen and Phase-3 page-layout estimates
Comparing Route A and Route B hypotheses under the stated allocation assumptions
not_valid_for: Official LongBench accuracy or faithful generation claims
Measured GPU allocator memory, HBM traffic, latency, throughput, or speedup
Claims about models, predictors, page sizes, or datasets outside the recorded scope
freeze_rules: Do not overwrite the listed experiment directories or hand-edit their CSV/JSON results.
New B=4 variants or accuracy runs must use a new experiment directory and separate manifest.
Route A results must remain separate from this Route B evidence and may not reinterpret its byte proxies as measurements.
